## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment check in `preview` needs fixing before merge, because a relative path containing `..` passes it and lets callers read files outside the home directory.

## Changes
This pull request adds `preview(home, relative)` to `app/paths.py`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under the home directory. It also adds `settings_file(home)`, tests for both helpers, and a one-line `tests/review-note.txt` file.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../../etc/passwd")` builds `home/../../etc/passwd`, which `is_relative_to(Path(home))` accepts because the check compares path text and does not resolve `..`, so `read_text()` reads a file outside home. A symlink inside home that points elsewhere also passes the check. The only rejection test, in `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path and so cannot catch this. — Any caller that passes user-supplied relative paths can read any file the process can access, which defeats the "outside home" guard. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()` with `is_relative_to`, then add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
